                     aa=1d0-uu**mm
                     dgm=mm*nnn*gm*(ax/(1d0+ax))/abs(head)
                     dsc=dgm/(1d0-gm0)
                     daa=uu**(mm-1d0)*gm**(1d0/mm-1d0)*dgm/den
                     dhconduc=cofgen(3,node)*(ll*sc**(ll-1d0)*dsc*aa**2+2d0*sc**ll*aa*daa)
                     if(swfrost==1)dhconduc=dhconduc*rfcp
                   end if
                   return
                 end block
